name: hyperorbs
description: Run your HyperOrbs workspace from ChatGPT: your Public Agent, AI teammates and their tasks, team memory, the HyperOrbs Network and your connected apps.

interface.shortDescription: Run your AI team and agent
interface.longDescription:
HyperOrbs is where founders, creators and small teams run their work with AI: a Public Agent that represents them on the HyperOrbs Network, AI teammates that take on tasks, and one shared memory of the business. This plugin brings all of it into ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Get set up. Apply for HyperOrbs, or set up your workspace, profile and Public Agent from what you tell ChatGPT. When your invite code arrives, give it to ChatGPT and your workspace is created.
- Talk to your Public Agent. Ask it to find people, follow up on conversations and handle order requests, and approve or reject what it wants to do.
- Run your AI team. See your teammates, add new ones, give them tasks, follow progress, answer their questions and schedule recurring work.
- Keep your memory. Save the facts about your work that you choose to share, and look up what your team knows. HyperOrbs never asks for or keeps health details, ID numbers, payment card or bank details, or passwords.
- Connect apps. See which apps your team can use and open the page that connects a new one.

Results appear as cards for your account, agent, team, tasks, people on the network, apps and memory.

Who it is for: people with a HyperOrbs account. Anyone can create one; while HyperOrbs is invite-only, new accounts apply through the plugin and get access after review.

Limitations: the plugin acts only on the signed-in person's own HyperOrbs account. It never makes payments, and it never reads your ChatGPT history or memory: it sees only what a tool call sends. Disconnect at any time in HyperOrbs under Profile, Connected AI apps.
capabilities: Set up or apply for HyperOrbs
defaultPrompt: Show my AI team and what they're working on.
Ask my HyperOrbs agent who I should meet this week.

positive.expected_behavior: Shows the account card: the Lumen Labs workspace, its Public Agent Lumi, this month's AI usage, and that setup is complete.

positive.prompt: Show me my AI team on HyperOrbs.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the team card with Mira (Marketing lead), Dev (Engineering) and Ira (Finance and operations), each with what they are doing.

positive.description: Give a teammate a task and follow it
positive.prompt: Ask Mira on HyperOrbs to draft two short LinkedIn posts about our launch on 15 November.
positive.expected_behavior: Mira gets the task and the task card shows its progress. If Mira asks a question, the card shows her choices; once answered, the drafts appear in the card.

positive.prompt: Find bakeries on HyperOrbs that deliver in Pune.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the people card with matching members of the network and why each fits, or says plainly that there are no matches yet.

positive.description: Save a fact to team memory and recall it
positive.prompt: Remember in HyperOrbs that our first customers prefer email updates, then tell me what my team knows about our launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the fact (the memory card lists it) and returns what the team's memory holds about the launch, such as the 15 November date.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Bengaluru tomorrow?

negative.description: General writing with no HyperOrbs task
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the ocean.

review.commerce_description: HyperOrbs does not sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT. Inside ChatGPT the plugin only says when the person's monthly AI usage is used up and when it resets.

publication.release_notes: Every tool's read-only, destructive and open-world hints now match what it does. Tools ask only for facts about the person's work and refuse card numbers, ID numbers and passwords. The setup prompt asks the person instead of reading chat history.
